say:1:1320501001:0.text: Chippy hears a dog barking crazily.
say:1:1320501001:0.source_cn: 咦，满满好像听到了很狂躁的狗叫声！

say:2:1320501002:0.text: Maybe it's looking for help. Why don't we look around?
say:2:1320501002:0.source_cn: 说不定是在寻求帮助？不如四处找找看吧。

say:2:1320502001:1.text: Why did that dog drive the sheep to us and then run away? Chippy thought it was a sheepdog too.
say:2:1320502001:1.source_cn: 那只狗……它怎么把羊赶到我们身边之后就跑了？！满满还以...

say:3:1320502002:1.source_cn: 满满，它应该就是牧羊犬。

say:4:1320502003:1.text: I remember reading the Lightbearer Imperial Atlas, which said that the weather in Cedartown is cold and the winter is particularly long. So, there are many shepherds here, and almost every family has a few sheepdogs.
say:4:1320502003:1.source_cn: 我记得《耀光风土图鉴》上说，雪松镇天气寒冷，冬季也格外...

say:5:1320502004:1.text: Maybe the dog hoped that we could lead the sheep back to their owner...?
say:5:1320502004:1.source_cn: 或许它是希望我们能带这只羊找到主人？

say:6:1320502005:1.text: Why us? We don't know where their owner is.
say:6:1320502005:1.source_cn: ……它为什么不自己找？我们又不知道它们的主人在哪。

say:7:1320502006:1.text: Maybe it went to find the other sheep. After all, a shepherd wouldn't only have one sheep.
say:7:1320502006:1.source_cn: 唔，大概是去找其他绵羊了吧？毕竟牧民不可能只有一只羊。

say:8:1320502007:1.text: Let's help look for the <style="highlight">owner</style>. We can't just leave this sheep here.
say:8:1320502007:1.source_cn: 先在附近找找<style=highlight>这只羊的...

say:0:1320503001:0.text: Where did all my sheep go?
say:0:1320503001:0.source_cn: 咩，咩——羊儿们，你们都去哪了？

say:1:1320503002:0.text: See! Someone is looking for their sheep ahead.
say:1:1320503002:0.source_cn: 果然，前面有人在找羊呢！

say:3:1320505001:1.text: Dura above, thank you all for bringing back this sheep.
say:3:1320505001:1.source_cn: 女神在上，感谢你们把这只羊送回来！

say:4:1320505002:1.text: I was going home, and then all the sheep I brought out today all ran away. I tried calling them back, but none of them listened. Then Sasha, my sheepdog, ran after them.
say:4:1320505002:1.source_cn: 我刚才正打算回家呢，可没想到今天带出来的几只羊全都跑远...

say:5:1320505003:1.text: I tried to go after them, but I couldn't keep up. My only choice was to wait here for Sasha to round them up.
say:5:1320505003:1.source_cn: 但我腿脚不方便，根本追不上它们，只能在这里等萨莎把它们...

say:6:1320505004:1.text: Where did you find this little one? Are there other sheep about?
say:6:1320505004:1.source_cn: 你们是在哪找到这只羊的？那附近还有没有别的羊？

choice_prompt:7:1320505004.text: Where did you find this little one? Are there other sheep about?
choice_prompt:7:1320505004.source_cn: 你们是在哪找到这只羊的？那附近还有没有别的羊？

say:8:1320505005:1.text: A sheepdog herded this one to us. That must've been Sasha.
say:8:1320505005:1.source_cn: 是一只狗把它赶到我们身边的。应该就是你说的萨莎吧？

say:9:1320505007:1.text: Yeah, that's my Sasha. She's very well-behaved and always sticks to the herd.
say:9:1320505007:1.source_cn: 噢，那肯定没错！我的萨莎很听话，会一直跟在羊群身边。

say:10:1320505008:1.text: If she didn't come back with you, it's probably because she went to find the other two sheep.
say:10:1320505008:1.source_cn: 既然它没跟着你们回来，估计是去找另外两只羊了。

say:11:1320505009:1.text: I think I heard a sheep to the <style="highlight">north</style>. Can you please help <style="highlight">bring that one back</style>?

say:12:1320505010:1.text: Alright, we'll go take a look.
say:12:1320505010:1.source_cn: 那好吧，我们会去看看的！

choice:7:0:1.text: We didn't see any other sheep.
choice:7:0:1.male: We didn't see any other sheep.
choice:7:0:1.female: We didn't see any other sheep.

say:14:1320505006:1.text: Yeah, she herded this one to us.
say:14:1320505006:1.source_cn: 嗯，是它把这只羊赶到我们身边的。

say:0:1320506001:0.text: Oh, it's over there. Let's herd it back to the shepherd.
say:0:1320506001:0.source_cn: 果然有只羊在这里。我们把它赶回牧民身边吧。

say:1:1320506002:0.text: Chippy will go behind it so it doesn't run away.
say:1:1320506002:0.source_cn: 满满来负责断后，防止它跑到更远的地方！

say:3:1320507001:1.text: Two of them are safe and sound, but the last one is still missing.
say:3:1320507001:1.source_cn: 已经平安回来了两只羊，只差最后那只老羊了。

say:5:1320507003:1.text: We didn't see her. Maybe she's still trying to find the other sheep.
say:5:1320507003:1.source_cn: 我们刚才没看见它，它很可能是去找你说的那只羊了。

say:6:1320507004:1.text: Let's wait and see. Chippy thinks that Sasha will definitely find that one.
say:6:1320507004:1.source_cn: 再耐心等等看吧！有萨莎在，它们肯定没事！

say:7:1320507005:1.text: You may not know this, but snow wolves often appear in these hills. Shepherds have been known to lose the occasional sheep or goat.
say:7:1320507005:1.source_cn: 唉呀，你们不知道……这片山区经常有雪地狼出没，我们这些...

say:8:1320507006:1.text: Can you please help me <style="highlight">find Sasha and my last sheep</style>? My family makes their living on these sheep. We can't afford to lose even one.

choice_prompt:9:1320507006.text: Can you please help me <style="highlight">find Sasha and my last sheep</style>? My family makes their living on these sheep. We can't afford to lose even one.
choice_prompt:9:1320507006.source_cn: 孩子们，你们能帮我<style=highlight>找找萨莎和那只老羊</style>吗？我们家全靠这些绵羊挣钱，可不能随随便便弄丢一只。

say:10:1320507008:1.text: The sheep is old and has poor eyesight. It always wanders to the strangest places, so I put a bell on its collar so Sasha and I can find it more easily.
say:10:1320507008:1.source_cn: 那只老羊年纪大了，眼睛不好使，总是跑到一些奇怪的地方去...

say:11:1320507009:1.text: Sasha probably heard the bell and went after it.
say:11:1320507009:1.source_cn: 我估计，萨莎就是去追它的铃铛声了。

choice_prompt:12:1320507009.text: Sasha probably heard the bell and went after it.
choice_prompt:12:1320507009.source_cn: 我估计，萨莎就是去追它的铃铛声了。

say:13:1320507010:1.text: It's common practice. Shepherds who have a lot of sheep will put a bell on the sheep to prevent the herd from getting separated.
say:13:1320507010:1.source_cn: 这有什么奇怪？像那些养着几十只羊的牧民，都会给领头羊戴...

say:14:1320507012:1.text: All you need to do is follow Sasha's pawprints, and you'll find both of them.
say:14:1320507012:1.source_cn: 麻烦你们在附近找找<style=highlight>萨...

choice:12:0:1.source_cn: 居然还有给羊戴的铃铛？

say:16:1320507011:1.text: Don't worry. Sasha has good hearing. She is definitely tracking the last one right now.
say:16:1320507011:1.source_cn: 不用担心这个，萨莎的听力很好，它听的可比咱们听的清楚多了！

choice:12:1:2.source_cn: 但我们一直没听到铃铛声

choice:9:0:1.text: What does the sheep look like?
choice:9:0:1.male: What does the sheep look like?
choice:9:0:1.female: What does the sheep look like?

say:0:1320508001:0.text: Magister, pawprints! She must've gone uphill!
say:0:1320508001:0.source_cn: 主人，这里有萨莎的脚印！看起来是往山坡上去了！
say:0:1320508001:0.male: Magister, pawprints! She must've gone uphill!
say:0:1320508001:0.female: Magister, pawprints! She must've gone uphill!

say:0:1320508101:0.text: The pawprints are different here. Was Sasha running?
say:0:1320508101:0.source_cn: 脚印之间的距离变大了，萨莎当时是跑起来了吗？

say:0:1320510001:0.text: Why is Sasha the only one here?! What happened to the sheep?! Oh, no...
say:0:1320510001:0.source_cn: 怎么只有萨莎？！难道牧民说的那只羊已经……？！

say:1:1320510002:0.source_cn: 别想那么多了，先救出萨莎吧！

say:3:1320511002:1.text: Good girl, Sasha. Don't be scared. We won't hurt you.
say:3:1320511002:1.source_cn: 萨莎，好狗狗……别怕，我们不会伤害你的！

say:9:1320511005:1.text: Chippy, look! Her leg is injured.
say:9:1320511005:1.source_cn: ……咦？满满你看，它的腿好像受伤了。

say:10:1320511006:1.text: It looks like a wound from a snow wolf. No wonder she's so angry. Chippy thought Sasha hated Chippy or something.
say:10:1320511006:1.source_cn: 还真是……看起来像是被雪地狼抓伤的，难怪它这么暴躁！

say:11:1320511007:1.text: We can't leave this kind of wound untreated. We need to stop the bleeding and bandage it. Let me think of what herbs would be good...
say:11:1320511007:1.source_cn: 这种伤口可不能放着不管。我们采些药草制成止血药，帮它包...

say:12:1320511008:0.text: We're in Duchy of Whiteridge, so using <style="highlight">crystalberries</style> and <style="highlight">snowradishes</style> would work. They are used to make salves and potions that stop bleeding and relieve pain. Let's go find some.
say:12:1320511008:0.source_cn: 白山公国能搜集到的药草里，<style=highlig...

say:2:1320512001:1.text: Oh, poor Sasha. The wound must hurt, huh?
say:2:1320512001:1.source_cn: 可怜的萨莎，伤口一定很疼，它看起来都没有刚才那么有精神了……

say:3:1320512002:1.text: Yes, let's hurry up and make a potion that will stop the bleeding.
say:3:1320512002:1.source_cn: 是呀，我们还是抓紧时间做出止血药吧。

say:4:1320512003:1.text: We need to chop, dice, and mix the crystalberries and snowradishes together. Then, we add water and boil.
say:4:1320512003:1.source_cn: 只要将收集到的冰晶莓和葱萝切碎，加入清水，熬制成药水就...

document:5:118:0.text: Take equal parts of frosted <style="highlight">crystalberries</style> and <style="highlight">snowradishes</style>, peel and dice them, then add a bit of water and boil to create a wound-sealing ointment for external use.
document:5:118:0.source_cn: 准备<style="highlight">结霜的冰晶莓</style>和<style="highlight">被雪水滋润的葱萝</style>各一份，去皮后切成碎块，加入少量清水熬煮，即可制成外敷使用的止血药。
document:5:118:0.male: Take equal parts of frosted <style="highlight">crystalberries</style> and <style="highlight">snowradishes</style>, peel and dice them, then add a bit of water and boil to create a wound-sealing ointment for external use.
document:5:118:0.female: Take equal parts of frosted <style="highlight">crystalberries</style> and <style="highlight">snowradishes</style>, peel and dice them, then add a bit of water and boil to create a wound-sealing ointment for external use.

say:14:1320512005:0.text: Nice! Let's leave the job of bandaging Sasha to Hammie.
say:14:1320512005:0.source_cn: 太好了，帮萨莎包扎伤口的工作就交给满满吧！

narration:18:1320512007:0.text:
After the wound is bandaged,
Sasha's condition improves significantly.
narration:18:1320512007:0.source_cn: 伤口得到包扎后，\n萨莎的状态恢复了不少

say:20:1320512009:0.text: That's strange. She doesn't seem to have any other injuries. Why is she still so anxious?
say:20:1320512009:0.source_cn: 奇怪，萨莎身上应该没有其他伤口了，怎么还是这么焦躁？

say:23:1320512010:1.text: It looked like she wanted to take us somewhere.
say:23:1320512010:1.source_cn: 看起来，它似乎想带我们去什么地方。

choice_prompt:24:1320512010.text: It looked like she wanted to take us somewhere.
choice_prompt:24:1320512010.source_cn: 看起来，它似乎想带我们去什么地方。

say:25:1320512011:0.text: It's possible. There are no traces of the snow wolves killing the sheep. Maybe it just ran away.
say:25:1320512011:0.source_cn: 有可能，毕竟这里没有雪地狼捕杀绵羊的痕迹，或许那只羊只...

say:26:1320512012:1.source_cn: 我们跟着萨莎过去看看就知道了！

choice:24:0:1.source_cn: 难道它找到了失踪的那只羊？

say:0:1320513001:0.text: Sasha is running towards the edge of the cliff. Follow her!
say:0:1320513001:0.source_cn: 萨莎往悬崖边上跑了，跟上去看看吧！

say:0:1320515001:0.text: So Sasha was guarding the sheep that fell off the cliff.
say:0:1320515001:0.source_cn: 原来萨莎是在守着这只跌下悬崖的羊呀。

say:1:1320515002:0.text: What a relief that it's fine! Let's go down and herd it back to the shepherd.
say:1:1320515002:0.source_cn: 没出事真是太好了！我们下去把它赶回牧民身边吧！

say:2:1320516001:0.text: Magister, no matter how much I push or pull, the sheep just won't move. It even headbutted Chippy.
say:2:1320516001:0.source_cn: 主、主人，这只羊好顽固……满满怎么赶它都没反应！它甚至...
say:2:1320516001:0.male: Magister, no matter how much I push or pull, the sheep just won't move. It even headbutted Chippy.
say:2:1320516001:0.female: Magister, no matter how much I push or pull, the sheep just won't move. It even headbutted Chippy.

say:3:1320516002:1.text: Maybe because it doesn't know us.
say:3:1320516002:1.source_cn: 难道是因为它不认识我们？
say:3:1320516002:1.male: Maybe because it doesn't know us.
say:3:1320516002:1.female: Maybe because it doesn't know us.

choice_prompt:4:1320516002.text: Maybe because it doesn't know us.
choice_prompt:4:1320516002.source_cn: 难道是因为它不认识我们？
choice_prompt:4:1320516002.male: Maybe because it doesn't know us.
choice_prompt:4:1320516002.female: Maybe because it doesn't know us.

say:5:1320516003:1.text: Sasha is still injured and needs to rest. It's better not to let her run.
say:5:1320516003:1.source_cn: 萨莎有腿伤，需要好好休息，还是暂时不要让它跑动比较好。
say:5:1320516003:1.male: Sasha is still injured and needs to rest. It's better not to let her run.
say:5:1320516003:1.female: Sasha is still injured and needs to rest. It's better not to let her run.

say:6:1320516005:1.text: Well, the shepherd said his sheep would follow the sound of bells.
say:6:1320516005:1.source_cn: 唔，我记得牧民说过，羊群是会跟着铃铛声走的。那这只羊应...

say:7:1320516006:1.text: We can use the bell on its neck and have it follow us.
say:7:1320516006:1.source_cn: 我们只要摘下它戴着的铃铛，吸引它跟着走就好了！

say:8:1320516007:1.text:
That's a better idea than pushing and pulling.
Oh, Hammie, the bell is gone!
say:8:1320516007:1.source_cn: 是哦！\n……不对，漫漫，它身上的铃铛不见了！

say:11:1320516009:1.text: Why did Sasha start barking again?
say:11:1320516009:1.source_cn: 奇怪，萨莎怎么又开始叫了？

choice:4:0:1.text: We can have Sasha herd it back.
choice:4:0:1.male: We can have Sasha herd it back.
choice:4:0:1.female: We can have Sasha herd it back.

say:15:1320516004:1.text: What? Magister, are you serious? The shepherd was pretty far, and this sheep is really heavy... It'll take more than three Chippys to pull this darn sheep along.
say:15:1320516004:1.source_cn: 哎？！主人，你认真的吗？！这里离牧民在的地方那么远，这...
say:15:1320516004:1.male: What? Magister, are you serious? The shepherd was pretty far, and this sheep is really heavy... It'll take more than three Chippys to pull this darn sheep along.
say:15:1320516004:1.female: What? Magister, are you serious? The shepherd was pretty far, and this sheep is really heavy... It'll take more than three Chippys to pull this darn sheep along.

choice:4:1:2.text: I can do it. I've been working out.
choice:4:1:2.source_cn: 看来只能把它推回去了……
choice:4:1:2.male: I can do it. I've been working out.
choice:4:1:2.female: I can do it. I've been working out.

say:4:1320518002:1.text: Yes, it's the one that fell off the sheep.
say:4:1320518002:1.source_cn: 难道这就是绵羊身上掉下来的那个铃铛？

say:7:1320518004:1.text: Wow, Sasha is so smart. We said the bell was missing, and she found it immediately. She really understood what we said!
say:7:1320518004:1.source_cn: 哇，萨莎好聪明啊！我们刚发现铃铛丢了，它立刻就找到了，...

say:11:1320518008:1.text: Sasha, if we just ring the bell, will the sheep follow us?
say:11:1320518008:1.source_cn: 萨莎，是不是只要摇一摇铃铛，那只羊就会跟着我们走了？

say:13:1320518010:1.text: Great! Let's have the sheep follow us to the <style="highlight">main road</style>.
say:13:1320518010:1.source_cn: 太好了！那我们就用它把羊<style=highligh...

say:14:1320518011:1.text: Chippy will stay here to prevent the sheep from running in the opposite direction.
say:14:1320518011:1.source_cn: 满满还是留在这里，防止绵羊跑到相反的方向！

choice:9:0:1.source_cn: 萨莎好像很赞同你说的话

say:16:1320518007:1.text: No, Magister! Hamster familiars are the smartest and the most well-behaved.
say:16:1320518007:1.source_cn: 不——不行！主人，我们仓鼠使魔才是最乖的！！
say:16:1320518007:1.male: No, Magister! Hamster familiars are the smartest and the most well-behaved.
say:16:1320518007:1.female: No, Magister! Hamster familiars are the smartest and the most well-behaved.

choice:9:1:2.text: Maybe I'll summon a dog familiar.
choice:9:1:2.source_cn: 或许下次可以试试狗狗使魔
choice:9:1:2.male: Maybe I'll summon a dog familiar.
choice:9:1:2.female: Maybe I'll summon a dog familiar.

say:0:1320519001:0.text: Just lead the sheep here. It'll know where to go after.
say:0:1320519001:0.source_cn: 把绵羊引到这里就够了，接下来的路它肯定认得~

say:3:1320520001:1.text: Thank you all for finding my sheep and bringing back Sasha.
say:3:1320520001:1.source_cn: 好心的孩子，谢谢你们帮我找回这些羊，还有萨莎。

say:4:1320520002:1.text: You're welcome, but it was thanks to Sasha that we were able to find the last sheep.
say:4:1320520002:1.source_cn: 不用谢！都是多亏了萨莎，我们才能找回这只老羊！

say:5:1320520003:1.text: Yes, Sasha is so brave and smart! I think she even understood us when we were talking.
say:5:1320520003:1.source_cn: 是呀，萨莎又勇敢又聪明，似乎还能听懂我们说话呢！

say:7:1320520005:1.text: Yes, we said that the bell on the sheep was missing, and Sasha ran and found it for us!
say:7:1320520005:1.source_cn: 是啊，我们刚发现绵羊身上的铃铛消失了，萨莎就找到了掉在...

say:8:1320520006:1.text: Also, she understood when Hammie was praising her.
say:8:1320520006:1.source_cn: 更重要的是……它似乎能听懂满满在夸它！

say:12:1320520008:1.text: Sasha is such a good girl! Look, everyone is complimenting you!
say:12:1320520008:1.source_cn: 哎呀，萨莎真是个好孩子，大家都在夸你呢。

say:13:1320520009:1.text: To be honest, she's always helped me with everything, like picking my cane or finding the bell. Maybe she trained herself...
say:13:1320520009:1.source_cn: 说实话，萨莎经常帮我做这种小事，就像是拿一下拐杖、捡个...

say:14:1320520010:1.text: Thanks to her, my work's been much easier to handle. Otherwise, herding these sheep would take me forever.
say:14:1320520010:1.source_cn: 也是多亏了有它在，放牧的工作轻松了不少呢！要不然，光是...

say:15:1320520011:1.text: I sometimes regret that she doesn't have a normal life. She's never allowed herself to be a puppy. She's been helping me since she was young.
say:15:1320520011:1.source_cn: 就是可惜，萨莎每天都要陪我放牧，没办法让它像其他小狗那...

say:16:1320520012:1.text: I don't think she minds. To her, being with her owner every day is the greatest joy a dog could have.
say:16:1320520012:1.source_cn: 才不是这样呢！能每天都陪在主人身边，这才是萨莎最大的幸福！

say:19:1320520013:1.text:
That's right! Chippy thinks so too!
Sasha, you think so too, right?
say:19:1320520013:1.source_cn: 没错，满满也是这样想的！\n萨莎，你说对不对？

cinematic_dialogue:1:1320514001:.text: Why did Sasha stop at the cliff?
cinematic_dialogue:1:1320514001:.source_cn: 萨莎怎么停在了悬崖边上……
